content: Taappe cimazappe, tumappe ta dosiza doorettida godatteyssinne izi naytas,
tana xalla gidontta tumaa erizayti wuri dosizaaris kiitettida kiita.
Gaasoykka hayssi tumay ha7ikka nu giddon dizayssanne sinththafekka mernaas daanayssa.
Xoossaa Aawappenne iza Naa Yesus Kirstoosappe kiyateththi, maaroteththinne saroy tumaninne siiqon nunara gido.
Ne naytappe baggayti Aawappe nuus imettida azazoza mala tumaan minni dizayta ta be7ida gishshas daro ufayettadis.
Ha7ikka godatteyee! Kaseppeka dizaaro attiin ta nees hara ooraththa azazo xaafikke; hessika nuni nu giddon siiqettanayssa.
He siiqoykka nu iza azazoza mala daanayssa; azazozikka intte koyro siyida mala siiqon daanaassa.
Yesus Kirstoosi asa asho may7idi yibeenna giza ammanontta daro baleththizayti alame bolla laalettida; heyta malay ay asikka as baleththizaadenne Kirstoosara eqettizaade.
Intte gidikko intte daabura waagaappe mela attontta malanne kumeththa woyto ekkana mala intte hu7es naagettite.
Kirstoosa timirte mala dontta asinne iza timirtefe balettidi kare keziza asan oonankka Xoossi deenna; Kirstoosa timirten dizaadey gidikko izas Aawaynne Aawaa Nay deettes.
Oonikka intteko yishe hessa he timirteza ekki yontta as mokki ekkoftenne saroka goopite.
Mokki ekkidi baso gelththizaadey hessaade ooson izara issino gidees.

Ta inttes xaafanaas koyza daro miishshi deessishin waraqataninne qalamen xaafana mala koykke; gidikkoka nu ufayssay kumeth gidana mala ta intteko baada intte sinththan inttenara haasayanaas hidota ooththays.
Doorettida ne michchey nayti nena saro geettes.

footnotes.text: Godatteyssinne izi naytas gizayssi Woosa keeththan diza abaaleta (ammaniza asa) bessees. Taybo 4-5 xeella.
